propositions: pytest-xdist worker process crashes with 'node down: Not properly terminated' and 'worker gwN crashed' on Python 3.11 when running test_matching_guard_is_accepted, blocking CI Verified gate

asyncio.wait_for on Python 3.11 consumes external cancellation when its child completes in the same event loop turn, leaving the worker task at queue.get() with cancelling()==1 while lifespan awaits indefinitely
worker teardown race under load causes OSError 'cannot send (already closed?)' across xdist channels during fixture cleanup when suite runs under CPU/memory contention
the fix replaces asyncio.wait_for(asyncio.to_thread(...), timeout=...) with async with asyncio.timeout(...) to restore correct cancellation semantics
defect is Python 3.11-specific; Python 3.12+ is unaffected due to CPython fixes
fix is already landed in commit 8c9bf5d78d and verified to eliminate hangs and worker deaths across 3/3 runs on py3.11 and 3/3 runs on py3.12
